source_evidence: Exact player 'Lets find out shall we' follows paymaster's referral to coxswain. Source pins retained dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4 and dm-ferry-ii.md @5b3e57c906b5e7bf90c45c870c42e320aaa01afa. Direct voluntary limited testimony of her own runs, actionable conditional assistance with passenger-safety concern, no invented V promise or automatic hidden plot revelation. No roll because ordinary conversation; actual uncertain promise uses prepared DC14 only after V's terms. D326~14:30 public quay at Orsaven ferry landing, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar with ferry coxswain speaking away from loading crew; coach/four horses safely at Copper Hart. Player exact 'Lets find out shall we' authorizes Cirren's suggested voluntary inquiry into unusual evening freight with the coxswain, not a voyage, seizure, pledge, expenditure, coercion or accepted further task. Coxswain is experienced working crew leader, concerned for ordinary passengers' safe return and workers' wages. She dismisses deckhands to finish ordinary loading, voluntarily acknowledges from her own experience that on selected evening runs cases are transferred aboard from another boat before assessment landing, some crew knowingly carry goods without ordinary customs processing. Has seen fine imported lace in cases; does not claim to know upstream supplier, hidden syndicate, bribe recipients or Quenwood's murders beyond public case. She is willing to discuss a later run and actual sailing information if V explains intention and assures that passengers can clear safely before intervention. No new sailing time, active transfer, inspection rota, cargo schedule or actual recipient fixed/revealed. Cirren independently says the fraud cannot be recovered by endangering passengers and wants to learn who arranged the payments; no pledge beyond his power. No uncertain promise yet, no persuasion roll, no crew warning, no threat, no commitment or confrontation. Paymaster's disclosed48gp balance retained pending lawful restitution, notification promised not confirmed sent. Original ferry guarantee and records in respective custodians' custody; no duplicate historic claim. Quenwood life sentence upheld, identified assets frozen, restitution distribution pending. Boatyard skiff freed, jelly defeated, daughter referral to Meret delivered; no new business contract. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP6/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 shield/boots, no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. Mara/coach/horses healthy. Purse2049gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR0/6. Royal recommendation pending, confidential Kestrel copies complete originals retained; frontier commission300+1300 contingent. Conditional western service-house grant signed not deed; Coris packet300 assessment pending optional800 field; magic commissions520 balance target353; Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated. Await V response to coxswain; no automatic additional action.
